# Firebase JavaScript SDK · 12.4.0

Unmodified compat bundles from the official `firebase@12.4.0` npm package,
downloaded through jsDelivr:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/firebase@12.4.0/firebase-app-compat.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/firebase@12.4.0/firebase-auth-compat.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/firebase@12.4.0/firebase-firestore-compat.js

Copyright Google LLC and Firebase contributors. Apache License 2.0, see LICENSE.
App initialization, Authentication and Cloud Firestore are loaded on the configured hosted
application. The downloadable file:// app does not initialize Firebase.
